hard_gates: Wheel selection must be deterministic: exactly one project wheel or fail closed
The isolated smoke environment must contain no editable install of the project and must import the package from the venv's own site-packages, never from src/ or a worktree PYTHONPATH
Evidence must be bound to source SHA + TREE + wheel filename + wheel SHA-256 + installed package version
UNKNOWN is never PASS; the consumer must reject missing or malformed machine-readable evidence
Existing required contexts quality/security/infrastructure and every existing ci.yml step must survive unchanged, including `python -m pip wheel --no-deps --wheel-dir dist .`
No continue-on-error, no `|| true` on decisive packaging steps, no job-level if: skip, no retry-until-green
CI-02 must not be weakened and must not be made required

A CLI invocation that resolves through the worktree or PYTHONPATH

Consuming unpinned dependencies from an arbitrary global environment instead of the hash-pinned project lock
Weakening existing tests, denominators or assertions to obtain green CI
